title: 第5章 女贼第6章 梅莉的面具
content_zh:
第五章女贼
格兰尔帝国只是洛亚帝国的一个附属国，依赖着洛亚的庇护才能在这个弱肉强食的世界中得以保存。
而现在郝宁身在的这座城市，名字就叫菲尼斯！
菲尼托斯中一个角落矗立着一栋两层小楼，它经历了这个国家好几次战争，直到现在它依然完好无损。
但这里的邻居却对此感到奇怪，因为他们从来没有看见过这里的屋主。
“这栋房子就是我第二个家吗？这身体的家伙看起来并不贫穷啊！可是为什么还要去偷窃，而且还住在那垃圾堆一样的贫民窟！
一个身穿囚服的身影鬼鬼祟祟地从街道中窜出，来到这栋房子的后面，从花盆底下掏出一把钥匙，其实这里是郝宁的另外一处房产，不过并没有人知道，就连他自己记忆中也没有太多关于这里的记忆。
“他就把钥匙放在这，难道不怕房子里被偷吗？”
“咳咳咳！卧槽，这房子究竟多久没有打扫了！”
刚推开木门，一阵灰尘扑面而来，郝宁连忙挥舞着手掌驱散涌来的灰尘。
当郝宁再次走进房间，首先映入眼帘的是一条昏暗的走廊，墙壁上还挂着一些人的油画，看上去仿佛就是恐怖片里面的鬼屋。在他的印象中这是他的爷爷，是一名成功的商人，他带领着商会走遍整个艾诺尔世界的国家。
此时郝宁心中第一时间不是敬仰这位厉害的商人爷爷，而是黑暗的大厅中摸索着，心中寻思着这里没有什么珍贵的东西可以让他兑换点数。
如果他爷爷现在得知现在他的行为，一定会暴跳如雷地将郝宁一脚踢出去，并且大吼：“该死的家伙，你给我滚出去，我没有你这个孙子！”
“这是火柴？不过放了这么久，这火柴还行吗？”
很快郝宁就在炉台上找到了一盒形似火柴的东西，嗤的一声！他竟让将这不知道放了多久的火柴点燃了！消耗了好几根火柴，郝宁终于点燃了蜡烛。
但这时候他才意识到这间房子有多脏，全部东西都蒙上了厚厚一层灰尘，随便一抹都能抹下一层像是沙子的灰尘。
“天呐！这简直…………？”
虽然郝宁前世也是一个生活随意的俺男人，但是像是现在这样，随便吸一口气就能让灰尘把你鼻子堵上的房子，他还真没办法住下去。
郝宁望了四周的灰尘，叹息着说道：“好吧！找东西也是找东西，顺便把这房子也打扫一下吧，从厨房开始吧！”
无奈之下，他只好拿起工具对这房子进行大扫除，毕竟任务期间，这里是他最好的藏身之所。

大半个小时过去后，郝宁的大扫除还是有一些收获的，比如从一楼中找到一些银器，这些都能兑换一定的购买点数。
他顺着楼梯走上二楼，通道中的只有两个房门，而且昏暗的环境让他不得不带着油灯打扫。
他进入其中一间房时，眼前的一幕让他整个人愣住了，干净的被褥和一尘不染的地板，而且在床上他还看到了几件女式衣服，这间房怎么看都像是有人居住。
“这……不可能有人住！”
郝宁记得“爷爷”已经去世很久，这座房子已经空置很久了，怎么可能还有人住，莫非有人闯进来了？
砰砰砰！骤然间楼下传来轻微的撞击声，郝宁心中一紧，连忙将手中的油灯吹熄，小心翼翼地朝楼下走去。他小心翼翼地向外探视，只见一个穿着黑色亚麻布衣的人正背对着郝宁。
从体型上看应该是一个身材不错女人，女盗贼颤抖着身体往后退了一步，她似乎对亮着的蜡烛发出的亮光感到一丝惊慌。
“原来是小偷！不能让她知道我在这，杀人灭口？”
郝宁心中闪过无数个念头，最终他还是踮起脚尖，缓步向着那个女盗贼走去。
当郝宁距离她还有两步距离时，女盗贼依然没有察觉她身后正站着一个人，猛然加速冲上去，抡起一个手刀往她脖子上切去。
“啊！”顿时耳边传来女盗贼的一声惨叫，她整个人都软到在地。
郝宁没有犹豫，立即从柜子中找出一条麻绳将她捆住，平放在椅子上。
绑好以后郝宁看着被绑的女盗贼，满意地点了点头，此时女盗贼的双手被绑在身后，麻绳还从她的胸前和双腿之间绕过，这样的情景光看上去让人感到热血沸腾。
没错，这样的绑法，郝宁是从前世某些动作影片中学到的，只是一直苦于没有机会应用到实际当中而已。
他直勾勾看着女盗贼的郝宁忽然感到口干舌燥，脸上尽是纠结的神情，内心的天使与恶魔已经开始争执起来。
“你妹啊！这不是你结束处男的大好时机吗！上啊！”
“郝宁不该把你珍贵的以一次献给这个陌生的女人啊！”
“你在犹豫什么！你的梦想不是组建一个后.宫吗？这就是你踏出的第一步啊！”
“这…………”
郝宁躁动的内心顿时被恶魔的一句话打动，他最大的梦想不就是组建一个属于自己的王国，然后无忧无虑地生活下去吗！

他的心脏不争气地剧烈跳动了起来，仔细打量这个女盗贼，郝宁还发现她是一个童颜美女呢！
金色的长发散落在肩上，微微皱起的眉头让人忍不住想要将它抚平。而且她的身材很好，就连身上的亚麻布衣，也掩盖不住她身上的诱人的气质。
忽然紧张兮兮的郝宁发现女盗贼的眼皮跳动了一下，心中大喊糟糕，她要醒过来了！
郝宁也没想到她会这么快醒过来，跄踉地往后退了两步，一屁.股坐在椅子上，脸上装出一个很严肃的表情盯着她。
那样子就像是一个法官在注视着犯人一般，不过郝宁很快就反应过来，他为什么要慌张地逃走？
“啊！不要……不要杀我！我只是在这住了几晚！”
梅莉朦胧醒来，发现自己被绑住，而且他还看到一个穿着囚服的男人坐在自己对面。
那个男人不怀好意地盯着她，冰冷的目光让梅莉心中一颤，结合郝宁身上的囚服，她已经把郝宁认定为一个入室盗窃的杀人犯。
其实梅莉只是一个无家可归的贫民，前几天她发现了这个无人居住的房子，心有侥幸地住了进来，为了不让人发现，她甚至在晚上不敢发出任何亮光。
但好景不长，今晚她从外面回来发现房子里竟然点燃了蜡烛，那明亮的光芒让她感到恐惧，就在那时候脖子上一痛，就什么都不知道了，直到现在她才看到郝宁。
郝宁直接开门见山地说：“你叫什么名字？还有把你在这这间房子偷的东西都交出来，或许我可以放你走。”
他始终还是下不了手杀一个无冤无仇的人，这个女人的眼神让郝宁心中感到愧疚。
梅莉神情惊恐地看着郝宁，那眼神仿佛在看一个杀人不眨眼的恶魔：“我叫梅莉……我不是小偷，我只是在这个房子住了几天！不要杀我，我真的没偷东西！”
“不是小偷？”郝宁紧盯着她的双眼，蓝色的瞳孔内充满了恐惧与纯净，最终他还是叹了口气说：“…………你走吧！”
郝宁走到梅莉的身边替她解开身上的绳索，但是他发现梅莉的眼神始终盯着他身上的囚服，顿时郝宁心头涌上一阵无奈，等会一定要把这套囚服给换了。
“你一定会认为我是一个盗贼吧？我是这间房子的继承人，那油画里的是我爷爷！”
“…………”
当郝宁已经帮她解开绳索的时候，他发现梅莉坐在椅子上低着头一动不动。
顿时郝宁慌了，他可没有对付女孩子的经验，只能强作严肃地说：“你怎么还不走！难道还想留下来吗？”
“我没有地方可去……”梅莉声音中带着哭腔地说着。

没有地方可去？现在外面可不安全，尤其是一个漂亮的女孩子在寂静漆黑的街道上露宿！
在这一瞬间郝宁竟然对这个女孩子动了恻隐之心，回头看了看空荡荡的房间开口说道：“嗯……梅莉是吧？我这里正好缺一个女佣，如果你愿意当一个女佣的话，我可以让你在这住下来。”
“我愿意！……主人！”梅莉抬起头，眼神怪异地看着郝宁。
在两人视线交织在一起的时候，她的脸蛋瞬间变得红扑扑的，脑袋上都快要冒出蒸汽。
“我的名字叫做布莱迪.郝宁，你以后叫我郝宁就行了，我没有其他什么意思，只是缺一个佣人。”
“郝……郝宁先生！”梅莉显得有些拘谨地说道。
忽然郝宁走到一边拿着扫把和抹布回来，交到梅莉的手中：“那么请你帮我把楼上另外一间房子打扫干净吧！”
梅莉还在好奇这个男人对仆人说话的语气，不像是主人和仆人，反而像是一个平等的朋友。梅莉以前从来没有享受过这种待遇，她们这些流浪街头的贫民，要么卑微地活着，要么就是成为贵族的奴隶。
“是，是的！主人！”
忽然梅莉耳边传来郝宁的呼喊声，她立即慌慌忙忙地接过工具，整个身体往前倾去。
郝宁还没来得及反应过来，梅莉一下子扑进他的怀里，双手环住他的身体保持平衡。
“梅莉……你没事吧？”
“对不起！主人！我不是故意的，对不起…………”梅莉红着脸蛋向着二楼走去，而且一边走着一边说着对不起的话。
“也许我可以进行一下女仆**！”郝宁看着离去的梅莉，摇头叹息地说着，但是他心中已经谋划着怎么**这个看起来有点呆的
content_en:
Chapter 5 Female Thief
The Graner Empire is just a subsidiary country of the Loya Empire, and it relies on Loya's protection to survive in this world of jungle.
And the name of the city where Hao Ning is now is called Phoenix!
In one corner of Finitos stands a two-story building that has survived several wars in this country and is still intact today.
But the neighbors here were surprised because they had never seen the owner here.
"Is this house my second home? This guy with this body doesn't look poor! But why do you still steal and live in a slum like a garbage dump!
A figure in prison uniform sneaked out of the street, came to the back of the house, and took out a key from under the flowerpot. In fact, this was another property owned by Hao Ning, but no one knew it, and even he himself didn't have much memory about this place.
"He just put the keys here, isn't he afraid that the house will be stolen? "
“Cough cough cough! Damn it, how long has it been since this house was cleaned? "
As soon as he pushed the wooden door open, a burst of dust hit his face. Hao Ning quickly waved his palms to disperse the incoming dust.
When Hao Ning walked into the room again, the first thing he saw was a dim corridor with oil paintings of some people hanging on the walls. It looked like a haunted house in a horror movie. In his mind, this was his grandfather, a successful businessman who led the Chamber of Commerce throughout the countries in the world of Ainol.
At this time, Hao Ning's first thought was not to admire this powerful businessman, but to fumble in the dark hall, thinking that there was nothing precious here that he could exchange for points.
If his grandfather knew about his behavior now, he would kick Hao Ning out in a rage and yell: "Damn guy, get out of here, I don't have a grandson like you!" "
"Is this a match? But after keeping it for so long, is this match still good? "
Soon Hao Ning found a box of matches on the stove, and made a sneer! He actually let the match that had been there for who knows how long be lit! After consuming several matches, Hao Ning finally lit the candle.
But then he realized how dirty this house was. Everything was covered with a thick layer of dust, and a layer of sand-like dust could be wiped off with just a touch.
"Oh my God! Is this simply......? "
Although Hao Ning was a man who lived a casual life in his previous life, he really couldn't live in a house like this where dust can clog your nose with just a breath.
Hao Ning looked at the dust around him and sighed: "Okay! Looking for something is also looking for something, so let’s clean this house too, starting from the kitchen! "
In desperation, he had to pick up tools and clean the house. After all, this was his best hiding place during the mission.
After more than half an hour passed, Hao Ning's general cleaning still yielded some results, such as finding some silverware from the first floor, which can be exchanged for certain purchase points.
He walked up the stairs to the second floor. There were only two doors in the passage, and the dark environment forced him to bring an oil lamp to clean.
When he entered one of the rooms, he was stunned by the sight in front of him. Clean bedding and spotless floors, and he also saw several pieces of women's clothes on the bed. This room looked like someone was living in it.
“This…there’s no way anyone lives in it! "
Hao Ning remembered that "grandpa" had passed away a long time ago, and this house had been vacant for a long time. How could anyone still live in it? Could it be that someone had broken in?
Bang bang bang! Suddenly, there was a slight crash downstairs, and Hao Ning's heart tightened. He quickly blew out the oil lamp in his hand and walked cautiously downstairs. He cautiously looked out and saw a man wearing black linen clothes.Turning his back to Hao Ning.
Judging from the body shape, she should be a woman with a good figure. The female thief trembled and took a step back. She seemed to be a little panicked by the light from the burning candle.
"It turns out to be a thief! Can't I let her know I'm here and kill her to silence her?"
Countless thoughts flashed through Hao Ning's mind, but in the end he stood on tiptoes and walked slowly towards the female thief.
When Hao Ning was still two steps away from her, the female thief still didn't notice that there was a person standing behind her. She suddenly accelerated and rushed forward, picked up a hand knife and cut her neck.
"Ah!" Suddenly the female thief screamed in her ears, and her whole body went limp to the ground.
Hao Ning didn't hesitate, and immediately found a piece of hemp rope from the cabinet, tied her up, and laid her flat on the chair.
After being tied up, Hao Ning looked at the tied female thief and nodded with satisfaction. At this time, the female thief's hands were tied behind her back, and the hemp rope was still wrapped around her chest and between her legs. This scene made people feel excited.
Yes, Hao Ning learned this binding method from some action movies in his previous life, but he just never had the chance to apply it in practice.
Hao Ning, who was looking directly at the female thief, suddenly felt his mouth go dry, his face was full of tangles, and the angel and devil in his heart had begun to argue.
"Your sister! Isn't this a great opportunity for you to end your virginity! Come on!"
"Hao Ning shouldn't have given your precious life to this strange woman all at once!"
"What are you hesitating about! Isn't your dream to form a harem? This is your first step!"
"This..."
Hao Ning's restless heart was immediately touched by the devil's words. Isn't his biggest dream just to build a kingdom of his own and live a carefree life?
His heart beat violently, and when he looked carefully at the female thief, Hao Ning discovered that she was a child-like beauty!
The long golden hair is scattered on the shoulders, and the slightly frowned brow makes people want to smooth it down. Moreover, she has a good figure, and even the linen clothes on her body can't hide her seductive temperament.
Suddenly, Hao Ning, who was nervous, noticed that the female thief's eyelids twitched, and she shouted in her heart, "Oh no, she's about to wake up!"
Hao Ning didn't expect her to wake up so quickly. He staggered back two steps, sat down on the chair, and stared at her with a serious expression on his face.
It looked like a judge watching the prisoner, but Hao Ning quickly realized, why did he run away in a panic?
"Ah! Don't... don't kill me! I'm just staying here for a few nights!"
Mellie woke up in a haze and found that he was tied up, and he also saw a man wearing prison uniform sitting opposite him.
The man stared at her maliciously, and his cold gaze made Mei Li's heart tremble. Combined with Hao Ning's prison uniform, she had already identified Hao Ning as a burglary murderer.
In fact, Meili is just a homeless poor person. She discovered this uninhabited house a few days ago and moved in by chance. In order not to be discovered, she did not even dare to emit any light at night.
But the good times didn't last long. She came back from outside tonight and found that the house was lit with candles. The bright light made her feel scared. At that time, she felt a pain in her neck, and she didn't know anything anymore. She didn't see Hao Ning until now.
Hao Ning said straight to the point: "What's your name? And hand over all the things you stole in this house, maybe I can let you go."
He still couldn't bring himself to kill someone who had no grievances and no grudges. The look in this woman's eyes made Hao Ning feel guilty.
Mei Li looked at Hao Ning in horror, her eyes seemed to be looking at a murderous demon: "My name is Mei Li... I am not a thief, I just lived in this house for a few days! Don't kill me, I really didn’t steal anything! "
"Not a thief? Hao Ning stared into her eyes, his blue pupils full of fear and purity. Finally, he sighed and said, "...You go!" "
Hao Ning walked to Mei Li and untied her body, but he found that Mei Li's eyes were always staring at the prison uniform on his body. Hao Ning suddenly felt helpless and must change the prison uniform later.
"You must think I'm a thief, right? I am the heir to this house, and that painting is my grandfather! "
"…………"
When Hao Ning had helped her untie the rope, he found Mei Li sitting on the chair with her head lowered and motionless.
Hao Ning suddenly panicked. He had no experience in dealing with girls, so he could only force himself to say seriously: "Why don't you leave! Do you still want to stay? "
"I have nowhere to go..." Mellie said with a cry in her voice.
No place to go? It's not safe outside now, especially with a beautiful girl sleeping rough on a quiet, dark street!
At this moment, Hao Ning actually felt compassion for this girl, looked back at the empty room and said, "Well...Meili, right? I happen to be short of a maid here. If you are willing to be a maid, I can let you live here. "
"I do! ……Owner! "Meili raised her head and looked at Hao Ning with strange eyes.
When their eyes intertwined, her face turned red instantly, and steam almost came out of her head.
"My name is Brady Hao Ning. You can just call me Hao Ning from now on. I don't mean anything else, I just need a servant. "
"Hao...Mr. Hao Ning! "Meili said a little cautiously.
Suddenly Hao Ning walked aside and came back with a broom and rag, handing them to Mei Li: "Then please help me clean the other room upstairs! "
Mellie was still curious about the way this man spoke to his servants, not like a master and a servant, but like an equal friend. Mellie had never enjoyed this kind of treatment before. They, the poor people living on the streets, either lived in a humble way or became slaves of the nobles.
"Yes, yes! Owner! "
Suddenly, Hao Ning's shout came to Mei Li's ears. She immediately took the tool in a hurry and leaned forward.
Before Hao Ning had time to react, Mei Li jumped into his arms and wrapped her arms around his body to maintain balance.
"Meili...are you okay? "
"sorry! Owner! I didn't mean it, I'm sorry..." Melly walked toward the second floor with a red face, saying sorry as she walked.
“Maybe I could have a maid s**t! "Hao Ning looked at Mei Li leaving, shook his head and sighed, but he was already planning in his mind how to kill this seemingly stupid person.
